boundaries.scope: Reference-attribution population only; not the full META-05/06 optional-field or conditional-agent-id inventory, full validation certification, or a prediction of all RFC0095 effects.
boundaries.trigger_assumption: Counterfactual canonical plus ANY own stated object-override resolution for BOTH inherited_assumption and market_data_accepted, including duplicate/shadowed/unmatched paths. This is not a new validator.
boundaries.as_of: String-only carrier shape in this attribution census. The owner-selected U3 calendar domain is independently assessed by the adjacent date-only research controls; this census is not complete date-profile validation.
boundaries.old_population: Only parsed.sections current single/variant blocks; convenience block.meta and current truthiness preserved in observed checkDataQuality.
boundaries.new_population: Exact-identity retained physical followed by current MODEL sections/superseded/pipeline_log/custom_calculations/custom_scenarios/extensions. No projected collection is silently dropped.
boundaries.intent: Location/path-derived classifications do not establish positive metadata validity or invent negative expectations.
boundaries.excluded: Embedded source literals in TS/Python/JSON test descriptions, ZIP members and generated Lite model blocks are not independent tracked fenced-source files. Standalone sources include test fixtures and templates where tracked with recognized suffixes.
boundaries.parse: Default accepted non-strict parser behavior is preserved. Parser refusals and non-strict malformed-JSON placeholders are listed separately. Parts are additionally passed through actual parseUWPart; invalid parts are never claimed as resolved.
